verdict.rationale: Choosing a data-storage region is a fair question for a cloud meeting-transcription SaaS, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents region or residency selection. Exporting transcripts to your own S3 bucket or Google Drive is an export integration, not control over where Otter itself stores data, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
